title: Representative formula for ordinary tensor restriction
statement: For schemes X,X prime, a morphism g prime, opens U,U prime, a commuting restriction j:U prime to U, and any cochain complex P on X, use the pinned ordinary tensor restriction iso [def-pc-open-pinned-single-tensor-restriction-iso] and the exact open restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. The map beta [def-pc-single-complex-open-tensor-restriction-iso] equals Q applied to the termwise inverse pinned tensor restriction map, followed by the inverse exact restriction localization factor at g prime star P. This is an equality before stalks or homology and needs no cartesian square or K-flatness.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma 13.16.9 (exact functors on representatives); Tags 0098 and 08DW for stalk/open comparisons. Detailed coherence identities: Mathlib Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/ExactFunctor.lean and HomotopyCategory.lean; lean/WeilConjectures/Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/ExactFunctor.lean.

proof.text: For additive functors F,G,T,R with R exact and e:F composed R iso G composed T, at the homotopy quotient of P, mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso(e) inverse followed by the identity composition factor equals the quotient of the termwise map e inverse. This follows by expanding the quotient lift and cancelling the identity component.

Use mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh_hom_app for R at F(P). Its quotient-comparison components and the homotopy quotient lift have identity components on representatives, so its hom component equals mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom; cancellation gives the inverse identity. Apply quotientCompQhIso_hom_naturality to the termwise map, then postcompose by that inverse factor. Specialize F to ambient tensor pullback, G to source open restriction, T to restricted tensor pullback, and R to target open restriction.
